\begin{document}
Let $x$, $a$ and $\beta\omega$ be real and nonzero.
\begin{equation}
\sum_{\pm} \left(\pm\frac{1}{x \mp a}\right) = \frac{2a}{x^2-a^2}
\label{eq:m1}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\tanh\frac{x}{2}\,\coth\frac{x}{2} = 1
\label{eq:m2}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\coth\frac{x}{2} = \frac{e^{x}+1}{e^{x}-1}
\label{eq:m3}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
\ln\frac{1+x}{1-x} = 2\tanh^{-1} x
\label{eq:m4}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
